purpose: A realistic response carries the evidence DPK-DAST-280 declares (hostprefix-missing-path).

groundTruth.rationale: The synthetic response reproduces the exact condition DPK-DAST-280 inspects, with the rest of the hardened header set present so the finding is attributable to this one property.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
